description: Default capabilities for the single app window. The frontend talks to agent-core over plain fetch() to localhost; its Tauri IPC is the native directory picker (dialog), the launch-at-login toggle (autostart), and the app's own quit_app command (needs no capability entry — commands registered via invoke_handler are allowed by default, see docs/DECISIONS.md). Generated tools open in an in-window <iframe>, not a new window — no window/webview IPC needed.
